title: Topological preliminaries for manifolds
description: The point-set topology a manifold definition uses: Hausdorff and second-countable spaces, bases, subspace, product and quotient topologies, compactness, and how these pass to the standard examples (spheres, projective spaces, Grassmannians).

title: Smooth maps, diffeomorphisms and smooth structures
description: Smoothness of a map between manifolds via charts, chart-independence, diffeomorphisms, distinct but diffeomorphic smooth structures, the standard pathologies (line with two origins, long line) and the role of the Hausdorff and second-countability axioms.

title: Inverse and implicit function theorems on manifolds
description: The differential of a map between normed spaces, the inverse and implicit function theorems, immersions, submersions, regular values and the submanifold theorem, with matrix groups as examples.

title: Vector bundles
description: Vector bundles via local trivialisations and transition functions satisfying the cocycle condition; Whitney sums, pullbacks and the tautological bundle over the Grassmannian; the tangent bundle as a vector bundle.

title: Partitions of unity
description: Existence of smooth partitions of unity on second-countable Hausdorff manifolds and their uses: gluing local constructions, embedding compact manifolds in Euclidean space, classifying bundles by maps to Grassmannians.

title: Sard's theorem
description: Sets of measure zero in manifolds, the set of critical values of a smooth map has measure zero, and consequences for regular values and generic position.

title: Whitney embedding theorems
description: Embedding compact manifolds in some R^N via partitions of unity, reduction of the dimension by projection (medium version) and the strong Whitney theorem placing compact n-manifolds in R^{2n}.

title: Fibre bundles and stratified spaces
description: Locally trivial fibre bundles with a given fibre, structure groups, examples from Grassmannians and projective spaces; stratifications of spaces by manifolds.

title: Banach manifolds, Fredholm operators and Smale's Sard theorem
description: Normed and Banach spaces as models for manifolds, compact and Fredholm operators, the index, and Smale's infinite-dimensional Sard theorem for Fredholm maps.

title: Transversality
description: Transversal maps and submanifolds, preimages of submanifolds under transversal maps, and the parametric transversality theorem that makes transversality generic.

title: Lie derivative, Frobenius theorem and foliations
description: Flows and the Lie derivative of tensor fields, involutive distributions, the Frobenius integrability theorem, foliations, holonomy and Reeb stability.

title: Differential forms and de Rham cohomology
description: The exterior algebra, differential forms, the exterior derivative with d² = 0, the Poincaré lemma, homotopy invariance and the de Rham cohomology groups.

title: Čech cohomology and the de Rham theorem
description: Čech cohomology of a cover, refinement, fine sheaves and acyclicity of the sheaf of p-forms, and the identification of Čech and de Rham cohomology.
